subject: Re: Sysenta MAP — integration playbook & POC environment checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan@sysenta.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Vasquez <elena@sysenta.io>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sysenta MAP kickoff — POC environment items

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, we want to lock down a short MAP so we can get a POC running next week. High level ask: we need an isolated environment with API access so our engineering team can run 48–72 hour load/light-functional tests.

Key items we believe are required:
- Org setup (single Redwoods org or sub-org for Sysenta)
- API key creation + scoped token for POC service account
- IP allowlist entries for our CI (we will provide IPs)
- VPC peering (optional but preferred for data flow)

I attached our current network worksheet (sysenta-network-reqs.xlsx). Can you confirm the minimal steps and an estimated timeline for each item?

Jordan
CTO | Sysenta Health
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan@sysenta.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sysenta MAP kickoff — POC environment items

Jordan — thanks, this is clear and the attachment helped. I pulled together a short integration playbook and a proposed MAP. See checklist below and initial owners/times. I also uploaded a skeleton MAP to the Drive link in the metadata.

Proposed POC environment checklist (minimal viable):
1) Org & user setup — create a Sysenta workspace under our Private tenancy, invite two engineer accounts, enable SSO if you want (owner: Ava) — target: same day
2) API key & service account — scoped key for tokenized access, expiration 90d, log token creation in audit logs (owner: Ava) — target: +1 business day
3) IP allowlist — we’ll add your CI egress IPs to the firewall rule (owner: Marissa) — target: +1 business day after IPs received
4) VPC peering — optional; if you want private peering we’ll open a ticket and schedule a maintenance window (owner: Vivek) — target: 2–4 business days depending on routing checks
5) Test plan & ramp — sample prompts, token limits, and a short load profile for your 48–72 hour run (owner: Sysenta + Redwood) — target: aligned with environment readiness

Immediate asks for you: please confirm the two engineer emails for org invites and share the list of egress IPs and the preferred CIDR for peering (if you want it). I attached a small worksheet for the details.

Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: sysenta-network-reqs.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan@sysenta.io>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sysenta MAP kickoff — IP allowlist & timeline

Jordan — looping on the IP allowlist piece. Quick checklist from our side:
- We need explicit IPs/CIDR in the spreadsheet or an email (no NAT ranges)
- Confirm whether your CI runs from fixed egress addresses or uses cloud-managed ephemeral runners
- Once we have the list, we can schedule the rule change outside peak windows (we typically do it in the 02:00–05:00 UTC window)

Timeline: if you send the IPs by EOD today we can have entries added within one business day. Also attaching the small peering diagram Vivek drew (vpc-cidr-diagram.png) to show required routes.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: vpc-cidr-diagram.png
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan@sysenta.io>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sysenta MAP kickoff — VPC peering details

Jordan — short technical note on peering so expectations are clear:
- We support AWS-to-AWS and AWS-to-GCP peering for POCs; peering is routed and we will configure (with your cloud team) the route advertisements.
- We require the target VPC CIDR and an admin contact for routing validation. For overlapping CIDRs we will either: change our peering range or suggest a NAT/proxy.
- Estimated work: 1 business day for validation + 1–2 business days for networking changes (assuming approvals).

Please confirm:
- Preferred peering CIDR: (e.g., 10.40.0.0/16)
- Support window: what timezone/time-of-day is acceptable for you for the cutover

If you prefer to skip peering and use IP allowlist only, we can still provide logs and a secure token flow — slightly higher latency for some calls but faster to provision.

Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Price <jordan@sysenta.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Vasquez <elena@sysenta.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Sysenta MAP kickoff — integration playbook & POC environment checklist

Thanks team — good plan. Quick confirmations:
- Engineers to invite: samir@sysenta.io, lucy@sysenta.io
- Egress IPs for CI (static): 54.210.34.12, 54.210.34.13
- Preferred peering CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 (AWS) — we’d like peering if it fits your timelines
- Support window: 02:00–05:00 UTC is fine

Next steps from our side: Elena will upload the signed NDA and a short network contact form to the Drive folder by Monday. Please add the two engineers to the org and provision a scoped API key for the POC.

Jordan
